world.b: Tehran said the escalating war in Yemen benefits only Israel, according to Al Jazeera's live coverage of the regional conflict.
world.title: Iran says escalation in Yemen benefits ‘only’ Israel

world.h: Iran targets US-backed oil shuttle in Hormuz
world.b: Iran signalled it intends to disrupt an Arab-operated, US-assisted shuttle system that has moved more energy exports through the Strait of Hormuz during the war.
world.title: Iran sets crosshairs on ‘US-UAE’ oil shuttle out of Strait of Hormuz

world.h: Trump says Russia, Ukraine agree to energy truce
world.b: President Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed to an immediate "energy ceasefire" but gave no details. Zelenskyy welcomed it, while saying Russia was still hitting energy sites in Kyiv and Kharkiv.

world.h: Iran calls latest US peace proposal 'insufficient'
world.b: The head of Iran's Supreme National Security Council said the latest US response on ending the war is "insufficient" and warned of attacks on regional data centers and cables if fighting intensifies.
world.title: Iran calls latest U.S. proposal to end war 'insufficient' as Netanyahu's corruption trial resumes

world.h: Projectile hits Riyadh airport a day after deadly strike
world.b: A projectile struck a passenger terminal at Riyadh's international airport Sunday, causing injuries, a day after a missile hit the same terminal and killed 12 people, the Saudi-led coalition said. The Houthis claimed responsibility.
more: The airport was still closed Sunday.

world.h: Pope Leo XIV to have lung surgery this week
world.b: Pope Leo XIV said he will have surgery this week to remove a "localized nodule" in his lung, found at a "very early stage." The operation is set for Rome's Gemelli Hospital, and the Vatican expects a weeklong recovery.
world.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week

world.h: Hurricane Simon nears Mexico at 155 mph
world.b: Hurricane Simon strengthened to 155 mph, just below Category 5, off Mexico's Pacific coast and was expected to move inland Sunday. It could bring 10 to 20 inches of rain to parts of southwestern Mexico.

national.h: Isaias moves north as Rachel batters SoCal coast
national.b: Isaias's remnants brought flood risks to the central Appalachians and mid-Atlantic after sweeping the Florida Panhandle, while waves from former tropical storm Rachel battered Southern California.

national.h: Dhillon reshapes DOJ's civil rights division
national.b: Over 18 months, Harmeet Dhillon has pushed out hundreds of longtime attorneys from the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division and replaced many with inexperienced ideological allies, NPR reports.

national.h: DOJ probes TV networks over Trump coverage halt
national.b: The Justice Department is investigating whether TV networks violated antitrust laws by halting coverage of President Trump after the White House pulled reporters' credentials.

politics.h: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's home
politics.b: Homeland Security Investigations agents searched the Minnesota Democrat's home as part of a criminal investigation, the AP reported, citing two people familiar with the matter. Details were not immediately clear.
politics.title: AP report: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's home as part of a criminal investigation

politics.h: Senators urge Trump to drop Russian diesel deal
politics.b: A bipartisan group of six senators called on the Trump administration to "immediately reverse course" on a plan to buy diesel from Russia to lower fuel prices.

international.h: Explosion in northern Israel kills teen on school trip
international.b: A 15-year-old on a school trip was killed and 19 others were injured in an explosion near the Lebanese border, officials said. The cause is under investigation.
international.title: Northern Israel explosion kills at least 1 person, injures 19

international.h: 139 dead as migrant boat capsizes off Djibouti
international.b: At least 139 people, including 15 children, died and 84 are missing after a boat capsized in the Gulf of Aden off Djibouti, the UN migration agency said.

international.h: Poland probes alleged plot to kill PM Tusk
international.b: Polish police received information about a possible plot to assassinate Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz. The Interior Ministry ordered action on the matter.

international.h: Drone attack shuts Yandex data center
international.b: A Yandex data center in the Russian city of Vladimir, east of Moscow, was shut down after a drone attack. The company said no injuries were reported.

international.h: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
international.b: Pakistan declared a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, effectively suspending the provincial government run by jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan's PTI party.

international.h: Taiz hospitals near collapse under Houthi siege
international.b: Yemen's government warned of an imminent health catastrophe in besieged Taiz, saying medicines, IV fluids and fuel at health facilities are nearly gone.

international.h: India's 'Cockroach' protest leaders freed, vow more
international.b: Leaders of India's Cockroach Janata Party youth movement were released from detention and pledged more protests over the removal of more than 130 million voters from the rolls.

business.b: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford won the Nobel in economics for models that help governments and central banks manage shocks like energy crises and inflation.
business.title: WATCH: 2 American economists win Nobel for studying how to deal with economic shocks

business.h: Big bank earnings to show Fed hike's impact
business.b: JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo and Citigroup report third-quarter results Tuesday, offering a first look at how the Fed's rate hike is working through the economy.
business.title: Bank earnings this week could offer clues to impact of Fed's rate hike

business.b: In a sluggish hiring environment, unemployed workers are taking longer to find new jobs, and in many cases their unemployment benefits run out first.

business.h: Musk vows affordable Starlink in India
business.b: Elon Musk said he would price Starlink affordably in India to take on Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Jio, days before Jio's parent launches India's largest-ever IPO.

sports.h: LSU's latest loss puts Kiffin on the spot
sports.b: Lane Kiffin harped on officiating after LSU's second loss in six games, but CBS Sports says questionable late-game decisions start with the coach.
sports.title: Lane Kiffin has plenty of complaints, but LSU's latest loss starts with the man in charge

sports.h: No NFC East team wins in Week 5
sports.b: CBS Sports' Week 5 grades give the Patriots and Packers an 'A+', while all four NFC East teams went winless, including the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Buccaneers.
sports.title: NFL Week 5 grades for every team: Patriots, Packers earn 'A+' while two teams get failing marks

sports.h: Commanders, Giants tie 27-27 after OT meltdown
sports.b: Washington ran out of time at the end of overtime with no timeouts, leaving the NFL's first tie of the season after Jayden Daniels went down with eight seconds left.

sports.h: Cardinals trade Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans
sports.b: Houston sent a 2027 second-round pick and a 2027 sixth-rounder to Arizona for the 24-year-old receiver and a 2027 seventh-round pick.

sports.h: Eagles' Sirianni takes blame for London loss
sports.b: The Eagles lost their third straight, 19-17 to the Jaguars in London, after a controversial decision with eight seconds left. Coach Nick Sirianni accepted the blame.
Oregon committed seven turnovers in a 17-15 loss to UCLA, earning an 'F' on CBS Sports' Week 6 report card for contenders. Ohio State got a 'C+'.

sports.h: Georgia still SEC's king after Week 6
sports.b: CBS Sports' Week 6 overreactions: Kirby Smart's Georgia silenced Bryant-Denny Stadium, and Saturday delivered dramatic upsets and a shifted Big Ten hierarchy.

sports.h: Oklahoma upsets No. 1 Texas in Red River
sports.b: Oklahoma beat top-ranked Texas 27-24 in Dallas as Arch Manning's late interceptions and special teams breakdowns caught up with the previously unbeaten Longhorns.
Quarterback Josh Hoover rallied the defending national champion Hoosiers from a double-digit fourth-quarter deficit to escape Nebraska's upset bid.
The Golden State Warriors and Brandin Podziemski agreed to a five-year, $110 million extension, according to multiple reports.

sports.h: Valkyries sweep Aces to reach WNBA Finals
sports.b: The second-year Golden State Valkyries beat the reigning champion Las Vegas Aces 87-77 in overtime to finish a semifinal sweep and reach their first WNBA Finals.

local.b: Gov. Kathy Hochul declared a disaster emergency over the spread of measles in New York.
local.title: NY measles spread prompts 'disaster' emergency. It didn't have to be this way, health commissioner says.

local.h: Man shot by ICE still has bullet in neck
local.b: The man shot by ICE agents in New York City last week remained in solitary confinement at a Brooklyn federal lockup with a bullet lodged in his neck, his attorneys said.
local.title: Man shot by ICE in NYC still has bullet lodged in neck, attorneys say

local.h: Mamdani orders review of NYPD force policies
local.b: Facing criticism from the left over his approach to policing, Mayor Mamdani announced a comprehensive review of the NYPD's use of force policies.
local.title: Mayor Mamdani orders review of NYPD use of force policies

local.h: NYPD Bomb Squad contractor faced LI scrutiny
local.b: A company that won a $23 million contract to build an NYPD Bomb Squad building in the Bronx was flagged in a 2020 Nassau County inspector general report for not disclosing who ran the business.
local.title: Company that won $23M NYPD building contract was investigated by LI watchdog

local.h: Mamdani: ICE agent looked like a mass shooter
local.b: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said the plainclothes ICE agent with a long gun who shot a Dominican immigrant in the Bronx could easily have been mistaken for a mass shooter.
local.title: Plainclothes ICE agent with long gun looked like mass shooter, Mayor Mamdani says

local.h: NJ Transit faces 5 weeks of disruptions
local.b: Starting Sunday, NJ Transit rail lines will see cancellations, new departure times and stopping changes as crews move the final track to the new $2.3 billion Portal North Bridge.
local.title: NJ Transit riders face 5 weeks of schedule disruptions starting Sunday

periods.name: Columbus Day
periods.text: Sunny, with a high near 71. Northwest wind 8 to 11 mph.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 61. Northwest wind 5 to 9 mph becoming light north  after midnight.

periods.name: Tuesday
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 72. Light and variable wind becoming south 6 to 11 mph in the morning.

periods.name: Tuesday Night
periods.text: Mostly cloudy, then gradually becoming mostly clear, with a steady temperature around 71. Southwest wind 11 to 13 mph.

periods.name: Wednesday
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 76. West wind around 11 mph.

periods.name: Wednesday Night
periods.text: Mostly cloudy, with a low around 62.
